verification_level: FAST plus BATCH plus the three affected SSL member-buffer adversarial probes; one documentation-only correction. No code defect, no UB, no ABI regression and no hidden obligation. src/ssl/record/rec_layer_s3.rs was deferred as a BIO/callback boundary and is NOT_RUN.
scope: Per-file contract audit of the eight head entries of REMAINING-AUDIT.txt. Seven were audited: the method-table constructors, the three QUIC reduced units, the non-QUIC SSL_poll readout, the s3_lib ticket/group/renegotiation surface, and the SSL_SESSION DER codec. The eighth, the record layer, is a BIO write/read callback and flush-resumption boundary and was deferred as instructed; src/ssl/ssl_cert_comp.rs was substituted from the next queue position so the batch still covered eight files.

defects.class: measured-divergence record inaccuracy (documentation only; not UB and not an ABI change)
defects.description: The module header stated that SSL_CTX_set1_cert_comp_preference/SSL_set1_cert_comp_preference accept the empty list (len == 0 or algs == NULL) and return 1. The admitted 3.6.4-production build defines OPENSSL_NO_COMP_ALG, and the authority's exports are `#else return 0;` for every input (ssl_cert_comp.c:362-382); the transcription has the same unconditional 0 (ssl_cert_comp.rs:455-460, 474-478). Only the helper ssl_set_cert_comp_pref, which is compiled out and unreachable, has the empty-list/1 arm.
defects.fix: The header bullet now records the unconditional 0 and identifies the helper's empty-list arm as transcribed but unreachable in this build. No code, signature, layout, allocation coordinate or exported symbol changed.
defects.witness: Authority source differential by inspection (forensics/authorities/src/openssl-3.6.4/ssl/ssl_cert_comp.c:362-382 and the OPENSSL_NO_COMP_ALG definition in include/openssl/configuration.h.in:80); the candidate's export bodies already return 0.

deferred: src/ssl/record/rec_layer_s3.rs: the write path calls BIO_write/BIO_ctrl(FLUSH) on the connection's BIO and the read path consumes a BIO callback result; it is a callback/state-machine boundary and was deferred rather than audited in this pass.
not_discharged: All audited files are file-level audits, not SAFETY_DISCHARGED and not SAFE_COMPATIBLE.

The QUIC units are reduced: SSL_inject_net_dgram's QUIC arm, SSL_set_quic_tls_cbs' ossl_quic_tls_new/configure success arm and the two set_* success arms depend on the Phase 15 QUIC object, which this crate does not build; this receipt does not discharge them.
The SSL_poll readout is audited only for the non-QUIC arms; the QUIC blocking path is unreachable because no QUIC object exists.
No new cryptographic or timing evidence is claimed for the DER session codec or the method tables.
retained_obligations: src/ssl/methods.rs: each constructor returns the address of a process-lifetime immutable static; the returned pointer is never freed and may be read by any thread.
src/ssl/quic/quic_impl.rs: s is NULL or live; SSL_is_quic accepts NULL; the QUIC arm is unreachable.
src/ssl/quic/quic_method.rs: the three returned statics are process-lifetime and never written.
src/ssl/quic/quic_tls_api.rs: qtdis is a NUL-function_id-terminated dispatch array; s is NULL or live; the stored callbacks are never invoked in this build because qtls stays NULL.

src/ssl/rio/poll_immediate.rs: items is readable for num_items records stepped by stride, timeout is NULL or live, p_result_count is NULL or writable; the export has no guard_ffi, but no panic is reachable for a contract-satisfying call (the only arithmetic is i * stride inside the caller-guaranteed readable extent).
src/ssl/s3_lib.rs: s is NULL or live; parg is NULL or NUL-terminated; the SNI control duplicates parg before releasing the incumbent (D563 ordering).

src/ssl/ssl_asn1.rs: input is NULL or live; pp is NULL or writable; decoded strings are the item's own blocks; a negative length or ASN1_STRING_FLAG_EMBED is refused before ownership transfer; the template item is the module's static.

src/ssl/ssl_cert_comp.rs: cc is NULL or a live OsslCompCert; comp_data is NULL or an owned block; the record and its data are released exactly once; the exports are refusal arms under OPENSSL_NO_COMP_ALG.
residuals: SSL_poll accepts an unguarded extern "C" export. No panic is reachable under the stated contract, so this is recorded as an observation rather than repaired; if the campaign later requires a guard_ffi on every export, this is a mechanical change with no observable effect on valid calls.
SSL_set_quic_tls_cbs on a complete table answers 0 where the authority answers 1 after building qtls; this is the module's recorded Phase 15 reduction, not a new divergence.

ssl_cert_comp's non-refusal helpers remain transcribed dead code under OPENSSL_NO_COMP_ALG; their contracts (CRYPTO_memdup NULL/len rule, alg in 0..3 bounded by ossl_comp_has_alg, TLSEXT_COMP_CERT_LIMIT = 4) were checked and hold.
documentation_corrections: src/ssl/ssl_cert_comp.rs: the measured-divergence bullet now states that the preference exports return 0 unconditionally and that the empty-list/1 arm belongs to the unreachable helper.
secret_bearing_buffers: The SSL_SESSION master key, PSK identities/hints, session ticket, ALPN selection and ticket appdata are secret or sensitive. This batch changed neither their allocation nor their release: i2d_SSL_SESSION borrows the session's own buffers into stack-local ASN1 strings, and d2i_SSL_SESSION_ex duplicates or adopts the decoded blocks into the session's member slots, whose release remains the session owner's. The peer RPK DER block that i2d_PUBKEY produces is adopted by OwnedBuf and released once. No new cleansing claim is made and no constant-time property is asserted.
